description_en: Restarts a pay-as-you-go ECS instance that has expired or been recycled due to an overdue payment
description_zh: 本接口用于重新启动一台已过期或欠费回收的按量付费ECS实例
kebab_example: aliyun ecs re-activate-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReActivateInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance that you want to restart
parameters.name: instance_id
